problems.root_cause: No detector for 'a landing reverses a commit less than N days old'. Semantic gates judge against the gap summary, not against recent history. The operator's re-fix (ca53600) did not cite the prior fix, so the recurrence was invisible.

problems.symptom: About half of dev-vessel self-modifications (78%/53%/44%/50% on 09-07..10) landed through patch_with_tools, whose only check was 'fs_edit applied and typecheck clean'. Every documented regression that week (f0cfb91, 550f2f7, 6fcdf40) entered through it. Refused multi-op plans landed arbitrary subsets (6dc2005, 76cef65, 9267810).
problems.root_cause: Escalation suppression and pwt containment were both gated on a region field present on only 2.6% of gaps. Refusal was non-binding and non-atomic. Fixed in part by 21da981.

problems.symptom: Post-land suite ran=false. The instrument named as missing on 09-10 was in fact present but dead from 08-31 to 09-28.

problems.symptom: Failures render as empty or zero: fetchKnownShapes 401 returns [] (100% of walks 0-step and oracle dark for 21h); dispatch error:None; skip-only and FAIL-only logs; wrong envelope returns 0; field goal_text returns null; /health 200 unconditional; written:N counts requests; coerceCorpus bare array gives 0 findings; watchdog ok:true while stalled_min climbs.

problems.symptom: Credentials and discovery repeatedly broken: every per-vessel key revoked after a secret rotation (09-10); MCP key revoked (09-10); project MCP key rejected (09-10); the cockpit cannot find goal-host via discovery while it is healthy (09-11); 8220 remapped to an unpublished 18220; memory 09-22 resolve-URL joiner overshoot.

problems.symptom: The gap write boundary destroys or replaces classification_metadata: replace-wholesale resets failed_attempts to 0 (08-29); the flat pointer drops the predicate (09-09); success:false on a landed write plus replace semantics means a stale retry reverts it (09-10); memory 09-23 'carries forward omitted keys'.

problems.symptom: Gates misfire both ways: computeNewlyFailing fails open on a null baseline and false-blocks on load-induced timeouts (5001ms/5000ms); vacuous gate refuses added logs and minimal edits but passes dead imports; comment-only changes are categorically refused; semantic_reject is a fallthrough (about 60% unclassified); the pwt judge PASS fails open.

problems.symptom: Most gaps are unmeasurable: 97.6% no falsifier (09-02); 758 none vs 15 armed (09-09); region on 2.6%; orphan gaps prescribe minting (114/114); template placeholders as status; the three pilot gaps filed with falsifier:none.

problems.root_cause: The input stream is mostly failure. Critical checks are scheduled by the mechanism they monitor. A sample is not evidence. INFRASTRUCTURE_UNAVAILABLE is not abstained.

problems.symptom: federation-transport restarted 19,348 times on a hubless deployment. The Syzygy spoke got NO_RESERVATION while the hub claimed a reservation. Manifest units are ungoverned by DISABLED_VESSELS. A spoke sink writes to a dead loopback store while advertised at confidence 1.

problems.symptom: Probe traffic inflates reach 2.5x (7 of 12 achieved = the same arithmetic probe). The dry-run gap_to_feature probe runs a real sweep. Operator lineage contaminates quiet windows.

problems.symptom: Operator docs diverge from code: compose volume prefix silently discards 16.7GB; the :obsidian tag is missing and :dev IS the obsidian stage (no CI target:base); image is public but documented as private 4 times; human surface port absent; 'full' does include desktop; the doc contradicts itself on default selection; the docs checker flags role names as shapes; coerceCorpus gives a vacuous 0.

problems.symptom: 19.2% of the retained execution rows are a revoked-key auth retry storm (auth_resolve_v1, about 1/s for 48h+). total_executions is inflated about 48x. reach_history has a row with no week and one with total=414,944.

principles: 'Every gate below this point READS the diff; only a test RUNS it.' The pipeline's own log, quoted in ADDENDUM sections A and G. The post-land suite that would run tests was itself dead from 08-31 to 09-28.

'The question has been asked seven times and answered seven times in prose. Prose did not stick.' Every expectation therefore needs instrument, current value, expected value, window and n-floor, and CONTRACT is never conflated with TRAJECTORY. (WORKING_SYSTEM_EXPECTATIONS_2026-09-02, the user's circulation complaint stated four weeks earlier.)

Principles written in prose do not prevent their own violation. The addendum violated its own rules later in the same document: md5 compared instead of counting results (section AH), and host loadavg read instead of container load (section AB). Every principle needs a runtime reader. (ADDENDUM method note and sections AH and AB)
'The substrate cannot distinguish "I could not ask" from "there is nothing there".' Failure rendered as absence hid a dead fleet credential behind a capability story. (ADDENDUM sections R and S)
'A rate computed from log lines is a claim about the logging until you have read the emitter.' Watch for one-sided branch instrumentation. (ADDENDUM sections N, O and AA)
'In this system, zero is the default return for asking wrongly; a zero is a claim about the question until the raw response is read.' (ADDENDUM section P)
'Read the diff, not the reason': verdict strings mix provenance and have reported failure over a successful commit 4 times. (ADDENDUM sections X and AJ)
'No gate asks whether the value being written depends on the computation whose outcome it claims to describe.' A dataflow check is needed against confabulated constants. (ADDENDUM section T, ae9210d)
'A baseline that contains the disease cannot diagnose it.' Use a median or high-water mark, not a pooled baseline. (ADDENDUM section H)
'A recovery counter that increments forever is a mask'; 'an escalation that only logs is not an escalation'. Both need a consecutive-outcome predicate. (ADDENDUM sections W and AB)
Count landings at the git layer (origin/dev), never from compose reports. Landing rate is not reach. Authorship is not agency when a worktree is shared. (ADDENDUM sections K, AO and M)

Partition before believing a rate: an alarming aggregate dissolved under partition (reach_ungraded is 86% infrastructure), and a reassuring 48% execution-level reach was 92% self-scanning timers. (ADDENDUM sections AA and AM)
Pre-register the reading before the first sample. A fail-open gate's PASS is not approval; only its REFUSED is evidence. (ADDENDUM section L; wiring proof Phase 2)

'A vessel's green is not evidence about its wiring.' Only a positive-control write through the real surface, bracketed by reads at the consuming store, discriminates. The response body alone is not enough. (wiring-green-vs-miswired-proof)

Rewire, don't mint, for orphan findings. Unsealing before fixing the prescription mints poison producers. A cross-vessel repair goes receiver, then gate on the running copy, then sender with degrade-on-old-receiver, then verify at the consumer. (WIRING_CORRECTION_METHOD_2026-08-29)
'Amnesia at the grain where learning would help and permanent memory at the grain where it does harm' (gap vs category). (WIRING_CORRECTION_METHOD link 3+4)

'Abstention preserves the learner; a HOLLOW poisons it.' Infrastructure-unavailable must abstain rather than take a beta penalty. 'A watchdog's success metric is the stall clearing, not its own exit status.' (WORKING_SYSTEM_EXPECTATIONS rows 7-8)

The highest-value result is not another template or commit. It is a reproducible chain: a known experience changes the right durable store, a later execution consumes it, and independently measured capability improves because of it. (COMPLETED_REPORT section 22)
Storage persistence, active availability and competence persistence must be measured separately. (COMPLETED_REPORT section 8)

Keep three measures apart: task service, maintenance, and operator dependence. An operator diagnosis followed by a substrate patch is supervised repair, not autonomy. Do not move acceptance criteria to fit a failure. (substrate-live-integration INTERACTION_PLAN)
Critical self-observation must not be scheduled by the selection mechanism it monitors: learned selection has no obligation to keep any activity alive. (ADDENDUM section B)
Reducing a change to one operation is currently the only reliable way to make a landing atomic. This is a workaround, not a fix. (ADDENDUM sections K and L)
When counting log events, match the log prefix, never a substring. In a self-modifying system the substring may be source code under edit. (ADDENDUM section L)
Activity counts and better dashboards are not gap closure. (ADDENDUM section AG)

'The doc is the system catching up to a system that moved.' The doc edit belongs in the same commit as the code change, and a checker that fails on correct docs trains readers to ignore it. (SUBSTRATE_DOC_DELTA; VESSEL_INVENTORY_DOC_AUDIT)
